name: official
description: Official KhonsuGraph plugins that are installed by name rather than bundled

plugins.name: DuckLocal
plugins.description: Parquet, CSV, JSON and DuckDB tables as nodes and relationships, read through DuckLocal

notes: Runs `ducklocal query` with the SQL of your mapping; a DuckDB file is opened read-only
The SQL you write can read whatever DuckDB can reach, including URLs

plugins.name: SQL
plugins.description: PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite tables as nodes and relationships, mapped by hand or from primary and foreign keys

notes: Sends only SELECT statements, in a read-only session; a read-only database user is enough
Reads a local file only for a SQLite database or a CA certificate you point it at
